list: Official PS5 trophy list, 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them; PSN progress counters as PSNProfiles lists them. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.

exophase.label: Exophase — official trophy list (names, descriptions, grades)

psnprofiles.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies and PSN progress counters

hub.label: GTA VI Vice City Hub — trophy list and 100% completion checklist

outputlag.label: Outputlag — GTA 6 trophy list and missable notes

insider.label: Insider Gaming — 100% completion task list, reported by GTA VI Vice City Hub

own.label: This guide — worked out from the official description; not yet verified in play

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task for it. The long pole is A Long Road (100% completion): finish the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles, and this pops with it. Budget roughly 200 hours across the whole list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — it unlocks when the mission ends, and the story cannot be skipped past it.
trophies.guide: Play the mission Gone Fishing to the end. It is an early story mission, so this is one of the first trophies most players earn — PSNProfiles already shows it as the commonest trophy on the list. Nothing to prepare; just finish the mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the chapter is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing in it that never comes back: meditate at Lucia's balcony spot, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears after Chapter 1. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter in case you miss it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the chapter is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. This is also the chapter where both protagonists become playable together, which opens most of the activity trophies — use the chapter to try activities (Master of None) rather than rushing the story. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the chapter is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the stranger strands and side activities are open across Leonida — clear a few between story missions so the later cleanup stages are shorter. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the chapter is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Before you start the final mission, make a manual save: the finale is the last point where a missed one-off can still be recovered cheaply, and the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the final mission is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. It is the only gold trophy on the story path and the gate to free roam after the credits, where the cleanup stages (collectibles, activities, 100%) are done. Save before the mission — not because the trophy can be missed, but because a pre-finale save is the cheapest recovery point for anything else you skipped.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to the end. It is a named story mission rather than a chapter milestone, so it pops mid-chapter when the mission completes. No preparation and no alternate route — just finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to the end. Heist missions in this game are multi-part, so expect setup steps before the heist itself; the trophy pops when the heist mission completes, not when the setup starts.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play to the end. Like the other named story missions, it pops on completion with nothing extra to do. If you are tracking the story trophies in order, this is one of the six named-mission trophies between the chapter milestones.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Headliners to the end. The trophy name is the mission's own wordplay — it pops when the mission completes. No side objective is named in the official description, so treat it as a straight story completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to the end — a mission set at Vice City International Airport. Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can, which is a separate free-roam stunt at the same airport: that one is an unscheduled departure, this one is the story mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to the end. It is the last of the six named-mission story trophies, so by the time it pops you are deep into the story — a good moment to check the Missables page, since the stranger strands and the Chapter 1 meditation are the things players most often leave too late.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Nothing in the 100% list is permanently missable if you keep manual saves, but the Chapter 1 meditation and the stranger strands are the two that force a reload when skipped.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion checklist: 35 tasks reported by Insider Gaming — story finished, 100 optional tasks and missions, all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 34 smash 'n' grabs, 50 stick-ups, all 8 bank vaults, fencing and laundering targets, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 30 magazines/books/comics, meditation spots, 100 cocaine flamingos, 2 unique playlists, 70 styles, 30 unique races won, 10 race gold medals, 42 shooting range gold medals, 4 video games, 5 pool opponents, 2 mini golf locations, 90 basketball hoops, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 15 Bret's target decks, 200 vehicles scanned, 50 standard weapons and 100 animals. Track it on the 100% page of this guide. Note the targets are higher than the matching trophies (300 stunts for 100% against 250 for Cunning Stunts; 70 challenges against 50 for One Last Thing), so keep going after those trophies pop.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: Stunts are repeatable anywhere in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: jumps, near misses, airtime and other driving feats the game counts as a stunt. They accumulate across the whole playthrough, so most players are well on the way by the end of the story without trying. After the story, chain them deliberately — long jumps off ramps and beach runs are the fastest repeatable source. The 100% list wants 300, so keep counting past this trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: Activities stay available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: the PSN counter tracks 9, so the set is the game's own activity list — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, pool, mini golf, drone races and meditation are the natural candidates. Work through them in Chapter 2 when both protagonists are playable and most activities have opened. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish any of them for this trophy.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: The range stays open in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the PSN counter is 0/42. The range is a repeatable activity, so practice the slow ones first and leave the timed precision rounds for last. Gold needs the top score band on every challenge, not just a pass, so expect several attempts on the hardest ones. The 100% list also wants these 42 golds, so this trophy and that checklist row are the same work.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: Drone races are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — the PSN counter is 0/14. Each location is its own race, so you must win at every one, not just win 14 races. Learn each course's line before racing it for the win, and note the 100% list also wants 42 drone time trials, which are a separate count from these race wins.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: Races are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. The 100% list wants 30 unique races won and 10 race challenge gold medals, so keep racing past this trophy: every unique win counts toward both. Vary the vehicle class and the event type as you go, and use the easier events first to bank the count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Not confirmed missable — but Cal's fishing challenge is a one-off encounter, and the game has no mission replay. Take the challenge the first time it is offered and keep a manual save from before it.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the game's activities — find Cal, take his challenge, and out-fish him. The challenge is the point, not casual fishing: it only counts if you win the head-to-head. Do it the first time it is offered, since no public source confirms it can be replayed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: Arcade games stay playable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. The 100% list wants 4 video games played, so this trophy is the first of four: play a different cabinet for each of the four rather than replaying the same one. Pick the shortest game first to bank the trophy early.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Not confirmed missable — but Andy's strand is a stranger mission chain, and the game has no mission replay. Finish each of Andy's missions as soon as it opens, and keep a manual save from before the strand.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger strands unlock across the map as the story advances — take each mission when it appears rather than leaving the strand for the endgame, because a strand that only opens in one chapter may not reopen later. The trophy pops when Andy's last mission completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Not confirmed missable — but Kenton's strand is a stranger mission chain, and the game has no mission replay. Finish each of Kenton's missions as soon as it opens, and keep a manual save from before the strand.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Kenton is also tied to the 100% list, which wants 5 Kenton sets collected — do the sets alongside his missions rather than as a separate cleanup pass. The trophy pops when Kenton's last mission completes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Not confirmed missable — but Billy's strand is a stranger mission chain, and the game has no mission replay. Finish each of Billy's missions as soon as it opens, and keep a manual save from before the strand.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Like the other stranger finals, it pops on the last mission of the chain. If a strand mission is not appearing, advance the story — stranger missions unlock as chapters progress.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Not confirmed missable — but stranger strands may be chapter-gated, and the game has no mission replay. Start every strand as soon as it appears and finish each one before moving far past its chapter.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the PSN counter is 0/8. The five named stranger finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight, so find three more strands beyond them. Strangers appear as map icons as the story advances; clear each strand when it opens instead of stockpiling them for the endgame.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Not confirmed missable — but Randy's strand is a stranger mission chain, and the game has no mission replay. Finish each of Randy's missions as soon as it opens, and keep a manual save from before the strand.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Randy's chain is one of the five named stranger finals that also count toward Strangers & Freaks, so it does double duty: the strand completion and the final mission both advance the silver trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Not confirmed missable — but Tyrone's strand is a stranger mission chain, and the game has no mission replay. Finish each of Tyrone's missions as soon as it opens, and keep a manual save from before the strand.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. With Tyrone done, all five named stranger finals are complete — check the Strangers & Freaks counter: if it is short of 8, three unnamed strands are still open somewhere in Leonida.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: CONFIRMED MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter. Meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — the PSN counter is 0/18. The one that catches players out is Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1: it counts toward this trophy and is gone once the chapter ends, so meditate there before finishing Chapter 1. The rest are spread across the state and stay available. Note the 100% list counts 15 meditation spots while the trophy tracks 18 — do all 18 and both are covered.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Hunting stays available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a specific target animal, not just any hunt. Bret is the hunting contact, and the 100% list wants 15 of Bret's target decks and 100 animals found, so treat this trophy as the first step of the hunting track: take Bret's hunts as they come and the unique animal is one of his targets.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: Cards stay collectible in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida, and the 100% list wants 15 sets in total — so the three sets for this trophy are the start of a much longer hunt. Collect as you travel rather than in one sweep: grab cards whenever you pass a known spot, and use the 100% page to track the running total.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: WAiNK spots stay available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — WAiNK is the in-game social app, and its spots are spread across the state. The 100% list also wants 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and that checklist row finish together. Hit a few WAiNK spots on every trip instead of saving all 100 for the endgame.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: Challenges stay available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the game's open-world challenge set, which ranges from driving feats to combat and exploration goals. They accumulate across the whole playthrough, so a player who tries things as they go will be close by the end of the story. The 100% list wants 70, so keep doing challenges after this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Wanted levels are repeatable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it and escape. The partner requirement is the point — do it during a two-protagonist free-roam session, not solo. Break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay out until the stars clear. Doing it with a fast car and a planned route out of the city makes the escape far easier than improvising.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Shop robberies are repeatable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level between them. Plan a route of three close shops first, then run it in one go with your partner alongside — the Wanted Level must stay live through all three, so keep moving and do not let the stars clear until the third shop is done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: Vehicles stay discoverable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or enter 100 different vehicle models, and the game logs each new one. The 100% list wants 200 base model vehicles scanned, so keep discovering past this trophy. Vary where you drive: city traffic, countryside, the airport and the docks each carry models the others do not.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableNote: Combat Focus can be used in any fight, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aiming mode. Pick a fight with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the five takedowns before it ends. A crowded shootout with cover nearby is the easiest setup; do not try it against one or two stragglers.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Not confirmed missable — but an unscheduled departure is a one-off stunt at the airport, and the game has no mission replay. Do it when the chance appears and keep a manual save from before the attempt.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport: get a plane airborne without a booking, in the game's own words. This is a free-roam stunt at the airport, not the story mission VCIA Takedown. Take a plane from the airport and get it into the air; the trophy pops on the departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Combat encounters are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: The official description is a hint, not an instruction: a Rhino is the game's tank, and 'kinda hot in these Rhinos' points to doing something in one — most likely causing chaos or surviving heat while driving a Rhino. No public guide has pinned the exact trigger down yet. Try taking a Rhino out and building a Wanted Level in it; if it does not pop, the trigger is a specific Rhino feat, and this guide will be updated when a source confirms it. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Jewelry store robberies are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, not a smash-and-grab. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try another store: the trophy only counts a clean run. The 100% list wants $100,000 of fenced jewelry, so a clean jewelry run also feeds that total.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: Bank vaults are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — the PSN counter is 0/5. Each vault is its own job: get in, crack the vault, get out with the Wanted Level live, and escape. The 100% list wants all 8 bank vaults, so keep going past this trophy until all eight are done.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableNote: Armored trucks run repeatable routes, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash and lose the Wanted Level. The name nods to the classic blitz-style heist: hit it fast and be gone before the response arrives. If the first attempt fails, another truck will come along the same routes.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: Exploration is repeatable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the PSN counter tracks 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk the whole map: Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the keys and the countryside all count. This finishes naturally while you chase the collectibles (cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots), so do not grind it alone — explore on the way to everything else and the counter fills itself.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableNote: Illegal operations are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — the PSN counter is 0/9. Each gang runs its own illegal operations around the state; hit one per gang. The 100% list wants all 39 gang operations, so this trophy is the first pass: one per gang now, all 39 for the completion list later.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Ocean Beach bars stay open in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take it in with the view. It is a small moment trophy, not a challenge: the game wants you to stop and look at the place. Any beachfront bar with a view counts.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: Showrooms are repeatable targets, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. Pick a showroom, line the car up with the glass, and go: the 'classic style' is the point, so make it a proper smash-through rather than a polite exit. Any vehicle showroom counts.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: The bowling alley stays open in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the alley named in the description. 'Follow-through' means finishing the game properly, so play a full game rather than one frame. One guide names a different alley, so use the Kolt & Associates one to be sure it counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: No part of the description points to a one-off event, so this is treated as repeatable until a source says otherwise.
trophies.guide: The official description is a hint, not an instruction: 'a partnership with mass appeal' points to something the two protagonists do together that draws a crowd — most likely a co-op activity done well with your partner. No public guide has pinned the exact trigger down yet. Try the partner activities (races, robberies and activities done together) and watch for the pop; this guide will be updated when a source confirms the trigger. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choices accumulate across the playthrough, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices — the PSN counter is 0/500, so this tracks decisions across the game: dialogue choices, approach choices in missions and activities, and the small either-or calls the game keeps offering. It accumulates across the whole playthrough, so just keep playing and choosing; there is no single choice that matters, only the total. If you rush the story without engaging with choices, mop it up in free roam afterwards.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: No part of the description points to a one-off event, so this is treated as repeatable until a source says otherwise.
trophies.guide: The official description is a hint, not an instruction: 'second time's the charm' points to succeeding at something on the second attempt — most likely failing an activity or challenge once and then passing it on the retry. No public guide has pinned the exact trigger down yet. If an activity beats you, try it again immediately rather than moving on; this guide will be updated when a source confirms the trigger. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: No part of the description points to a one-off event, so this is treated as repeatable until a source says otherwise.
trophies.guide: The official description is a hint, not an instruction: 'what the hell just happened?' points to stumbling on something strange — the game's oddity or easter-egg moment, the kind of thing players find by exploring the weird corners of Leonida. No public guide has pinned the exact trigger down yet. Explore the strange places (the swamps, the keys, the odd landmarks) and it will find you; this guide will be updated when a source confirms the trigger. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: Bowling pins and drive-bys are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock bowling pins over from a moving vehicle using a melee weapon. Set it up near the bowling alley: drive past the pins slowly and swing as you go. It is a stunt with a joke built in, so expect a few attempts before the pins fall the way the game wants.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableNote: Laundering stays available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — the PSN counter is 0/250000. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; launder them through contacts rather than spending them dirty. The 100% list wants the same $250,000 laundered, so this trophy and that checklist row finish together. Bank vaults and armored trucks are the steadiest source of Marked Bills.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableNote: Shops stay open in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the PSN counter is 0/100000, and it counts spending everywhere, not in one shop. Buy what you actually want (weapons, clothes, car upgrades) and the total climbs on its own; by the endgame most players are close. If you are short, buy and sell high-value items across several shops rather than dumping it all in one place.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableNote: Properties stay buyable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — the PSN counter is 0/8. Garages are bought around Leonida as the story opens the map; each one is a property purchase, not a rental. Save up through the story's heists and the vault robberies, then buy the remaining garages in one sweep once you can afford them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableNote: Vehicle registration stays available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the PSN counter is 0/10. Find a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app and register it; repeat with ten different vehicles. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles): register the interesting ones as you discover them and both counters climb together.
